title: South Salt Lake Man Busted After Alleged ICE Threats In Rape, Extortion Case - NewsBreak
text:
By Ella Richardson ,
8 hours ago Police say a 57-year-old man was arrested Wednesday in South Salt Lake and charged with first-degree rape and sexual extortion after allegedly using a woman's immigration status as leverage. According to court documents, investigators say he coerced her by threatening to report her to immigration authorities and to take custody of her child. Authorities allege the most recent assault happened on April 18 and that similar coercive encounters occurred as often as once a week beginning in June 2025. Read full article
